By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[3963 BBY]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Taris Siege|invasion]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], this '''reporter''' worked for the ''[[Taris Holofeed]]''. During the siege, this reporter and his staff holed up in the [[Senatorial Suite]] of the [[Junavex Hotel]], giving a live report of the Mandalorian attack. Eventually, the Mandalorians moved into the hotel itself, disrupting the transmission.
